verdict.rationale: Ghostty's docs say it renders ligature fonts correctly and lets users enable or disable specific font features (e.g. `-calt` to turn off programming ligatures), applied across all rendered fonts. The font setting can be repeated to define fallback fonts for missing codepoints, and it embeds JetBrains Mono plus built-in Nerd Fonts. Missing for 10: evidence of fine-grained tuning beyond font features (e.g. size, metrics or cell adjustments) and independent or hands-on corroboration of ligature and fallback behavior.
